title: War starts when people stop talking
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: When you stop talking to someone, what starts?

groups.heading: Do whatever you need to do to get it done

lines.text: I said this chapter has two or three major lessons for him. One is how strategic and visionary the author is, how he takes risks and thinks outside the box.

As I retell it, the author told the reporter covering a war: do whatever you need to do to get it done, I don't care about the budget. The cost could have been anywhere between two and thirty-five million dollars. I said he was amazed it got through the board.
A student said the biggest thing was that when the other news channels were covering the channel itself, it set them apart and took them to a completely different level.
I said: everybody else is behind a desk, and here is this man negotiating with government officials to cover the war on both sides. He is creating cultural bridges between two countries at war.
I said I love one of the author's lines. A student read it.
War starts when people stop talking.
Now he is reaching another level of foreign politics and sensitivity, I said. We have talked about being unbiased and unprejudiced and the privileges it brings.

How brilliant is it, I said, that he calls the program a world report. It is not American journalism. It is world report. He makes it inclusive to all the countries. He is changing the image of the channel again.
What would you change about the name of what you do, to make it inclusive?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write a conversation you stopped having.
Write what has grown in its place.
Write one thing you could say to restart it.
Write the name or promise of what you do, and who it leaves out.
Write one way to make it more inclusive.

check.q: What did the student read as the author's line?
choices: War starts when people stop talking

check.q: What did I say about the name 'world report'?
choices: It makes it inclusive to all the countries

check.q: What did I say the other news channels were doing while the author negotiated?

recap: Keep talking. Name what you do so that it is inclusive.
